note: Deterministic regional-register markers for Vietnamese (bac/trung/nam). High-precision / low-recall: most short messages score below threshold and stay neutral. Region is a per-conversation register hint only, never a stored identity attribute and never spoken aloud. Focus Nam first (HCMC). Design: docs/foundation/kael-regional-register-research.md. This file is register DATA and is versioned independently (lexicon_version), not swept by the charter_version sync-contract.

A.description: Strong, near-decisive markers (mostly Trung / Bac-Trung). Detect-only: NEVER mirrored back, so Kael never parrots strong dialect.

B.description: Lexical, medium confidence. Mirror-eligible: Kael may gently echo the customer's own everyday word choice.

C.description: Weak particles and phonetic spellings. Mirror-eligible only for warm neutral particles.

negative_rules: Never state or ask the customer's region ('Bạn người miền ... à?').
Never infer ethnicity, class, hometown, or any demographic from register.
Never store region as a durable customer attribute; it is per-conversation only.
Never log the region inference together with PII (RULES #9).
Conflicting strong markers or no markers => neutral (default_region), never a guess.
Never mimic strong (tier A) dialect back to the customer; mirror-lite echoes only the customer's own everyday words and warm particles.
